consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: contractor
consultations.section: Contracted person/company noun; building and independent contractor examples
consultations.finding: A contracted provider may be a person or a company and may undertake work or provide goods/services. The office repair example fits the selected contracted-work sense. No selected headword CEFR label was observed; the footer level belongs to enhance.

consultations.section: Person receiving job training; Education/Jobs label
consultations.finding: The role is a person receiving training for a particular job, rather than any worker who happens to be learning. Teacher and management training are examples of role context, not added accepted answers. The selected topic label is B2.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: contact
consultations.section: Countable person sense 4; point of contact idiom; contrasting noun senses
consultations.finding: The selected person is known as a useful source of help or information, especially through work. Point of contact can instead identify a person or place approached in organizational dealings. Communication, physical touching, electrical connection and medical exposure senses are separate. No selected person-sense CEFR label was observed.

consultations.section: Work time-plan sense 1; Working life label; separate timetable/list senses
consultations.finding: The selected sense plans when work or activities happen and carries A2. School, transport and broadcast timetables and written lists of rates or conditions are separately distinguished. Regional labels attached to timetable senses do not restrict the general workplace time-plan noun.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: shift
consultations.section: Work-period noun sense 1; Business label; other noun senses
consultations.finding: The work-period sense is illustrated through successive worker groups and individual shifts and carries B1. A worker group, a change, the keyboard key and a garment are different uses. The selected period does not establish a rule excluding breaks.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: appointment
consultations.section: Arranged meeting/visit sense 1; Healthcare/Working life label
consultations.finding: The selected arrangement is to meet or visit at a stated time, including work or service appointments, and carries B1. Appointment to a job or position is separate. No particular appointment duration or outcome is implied.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: meeting
consultations.section: Discussion/decision gathering sense 1; Working life/Business label
consultations.finding: The selected event brings people together to discuss matters or decide and carries A1. Video and virtual meetings are compatible, so physical co-location is unnecessary. Chance encounters and meeting-point rendezvous wording should not be automatically bound to this work-discussion sense.

consultations.title: Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner's Dictionary: contact
consultations.section: Countable helpful-person sense 10; communication verb and contact-details contrasts
consultations.finding: The useful-person sense identifies someone known in an organization or profession who can help or provide information. Its displayed label is B1+, which is retained literally rather than converted to a schema value. The separate communication verb is A2 and communication noun is B1; neither level transfers to this person sense.

Movement, policy change and gear-change senses are excluded.
